what_this_is: The COMPLETE 8x topology ladder for malaiwah/Qwen3.8-27B-EXL3-K5K6-hydrated on one host (jl-vm-473501, 8x RTX PRO 6000, ForceP2P applied). Four arms were planned; three ran and the fourth is architecturally impossible. Same host, same image, same knobs, one variable (topology).

gates.TP8: NOT REACHED - engine refuses to start

gate_methodology_note: A --tp-smoke gate downgrades the needle to 32k. The TP4xDP2 arm was FIRST gated that way and then RE-gated at the full 262144-token needle so it is comparable to the other arms. Never compare a tp-smoke gate against a full-needle gate.
shape_coverage_note: 30kx2k was run only on the TP4xDP2 arm; DP8 and TP2xDP4 predate that shape being in the default ladder. The cross-arm comparisons below use 512x256 and 4kx1k, which all three arms ran.

tp8_refusal.verdict: TP8 IS IMPOSSIBLE for this model, and this is an architectural bound, not a misconfiguration.
tp8_refusal.error: ValueError: EXL3 TP output slice must be 128-aligned, got start=62080, size=31040

derivation.conclusion: EXL3 trellis tensors shard only on 128-element boundaries. The projection's output dim is 248320 = 128 x 1940 and 1940 = 4 x 485 with 485 odd, so the tile count divides by 4 but not by 8. MAX TENSOR-PARALLEL WIDTH FOR THIS MODEL IS EXACTLY 4, on any GPU count.

tp8_refusal.consequence: An 8-GPU host cannot be driven as one tensor-parallel replica. Every 8x configuration must use data parallelism for at least a factor of 2, which is why the ladder's four planned arms are really three.

findings.evidence: 512x256 C128: DP8 3552.6 vs TP2xDP4 2438.2 vs TP4xDP2 2205.6 tok/s. DP8 is +45.7 % over TP2xDP4.

findings.claim: Single-stream latency optimum depends on prompt length, and TP2 is not always the winner.
findings.evidence: 512x256 C1: TP2xDP4 153.2 > TP4xDP2 146.5 > DP8 135.2. But 4kx1k C1: TP4xDP2 109.3 > TP2xDP4 105.8 > DP8 90.1. Wider TP pays off only once the prompt gives it enough work to split.

findings.claim: TP4xDP2 is DOMINATED at short shapes - worse on BOTH axes than TP2xDP4.
findings.evidence: 512x256: single-stream 146.5 < 153.2 and peak 2205.6 < 2438.2. There is no short-prompt reason to pick it.

findings.claim: THE KNEE TRACKS THE DATA-PARALLEL DEGREE, NOT THE GPU COUNT.
findings.evidence: 512x256 and 4kx1k agree exactly: DP8 (DP=8) knee C32, TP2xDP4 (DP=4) knee C16, TP4xDP2 (DP=2) knee C8. All three are 4 x DP. This restates the earlier 'knee ~ 4N' rule correctly: N is the number of data-parallel REPLICAS, and adding TP width inside a replica does not raise the knee - it lowers it in proportion.

findings.claim: Zero refusals across all three arms and all rungs.
findings.evidence: refused_or_errored == 0 in every cell of every arm, 1 through 128 concurrent.

serving_recommendation.throughput: DP8 - 3553 tok/s at C128, knee C32.
serving_recommendation.latency: TP2xDP4 for short prompts (153.2 tok/s single-stream); TP4xDP2 only if prompts are >= ~4k.
serving_recommendation.never: TP8 - refused by EXL3 at load time.
serving_recommendation.rule_of_thumb: Size concurrency to 4 x data-parallel degree; that is where the per-request floor still holds.
